items.quote: So, while some people see just a train, I see a blueprint for the next phase of real estate expansion in the UAE.
items.statement: I see Etihad Rail as a blueprint for the next phase of real estate expansion in the UAE.

items.quote: we’re looking at previously untapped areas becoming prime real estate hotspots.
items.statement: New connectivity across the UAE will create prime real estate hotspots.

items.quote: Less traffic in central areas? Yes, please. More affordable housing options? Finally.
items.statement: Etihad Rail may result in less traffic in central areas and more affordable housing options.

items.quote: It opens doors (and tracks) to new workforce hubs, suburban communities.
items.statement: Etihad Rail opens doors to new workforce hubs and suburban communities.

items.quote: For years, certain parts of the UAE have been off the radar simply because getting there was a logistical nightmare.
items.statement: Certain parts of the UAE have previously been neglected due to logistical challenges.
